name: progressive-blur
blurb: Progressive blur overlay fades content from edges with layered blur effects.
description: Renders a layered backdrop blur overlay that progressively obscures content from top, bottom, or both edges using CSS backdrop filters and mask gradients.
use_when: Content overflow indicators, fade-to-obscurity effects, or elegantly blurring content at container edges.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical content that must not be obscured or hidden.
a11y: Visual blur effect; non-interactive. No semantic content or keyboard interaction.
